map.计算客户流失率，评估客户留存和业务健康度: Compute customer churn rate and assess retention and business health
map.📖 查看「客户流失率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Customer Churn Rate Calculator User Guide"
map.统计周期开始时的客户数量: Number of customers at the start of the period
map.统计周期结束时的客户数量: Number of customers at the end of the period
map.统计周期内新增的客户数量: New customers added during the period
map.可选，用于计算收入损失: Optional, used to compute revenue loss
map.客户流失率（Churn Rate）是指在一定时间内流失客户占总客户数的比例。它是: Churn rate is the share of lost customers out of the total customer base over a period. It is the key measure of customer loyalty and business sustainability.
map.流失率 = (期初客户数 - 期末客户数 + 新增客户数) ÷ 期初客户数 ×: Churn rate = (starting customers - ending customers + new customers) / starting customers × 100%
map.简化公式：流失率 = 流失客户数 ÷ 期初客户数 × 100%: Simplified formula: churn rate = lost customers / starting customers × 100%
map.例如：期初1000个客户，期末950个，新增80个，流失数 = 1000 + 8: For example with 1000 customers at the start, 950 at the end and 80 added, churn = 1000 + 80 - 950 = 130 and churn rate = 130 / 1000 = 13%
map.：流失客户意味着持续收入损失: : churned customers mean recurring revenue is lost
map.：获取新客户成本是留存老客户的5-25倍: : winning a new customer costs 5-25 times more than keeping an existing one
map.：高流失率通常意味着产品体验有问题: : high churn usually signals problems with the product experience
map.：低流失率才能实现复利式增长: : only low churn allows compounding growth
map.= 月均收入 ÷ 月流失率（毛收入口径）: = average monthly revenue / monthly churn rate (gross revenue basis)
map.：持续优化产品体验和核心功能: : keep improving the product experience and core features
map.：主动帮助客户达成目标，减少主动流失: : proactively help customers reach their goals to cut voluntary churn
map.：忠诚度计划、长期折扣等: : loyalty programs, long-term discounts and similar
map.：建立流失预警机制，及时干预: : build a churn warning system and intervene in time
map.：客服问题快速解决，降低被动流失: : resolve support issues quickly to cut involuntary churn
map.月度看流失率判断留存健康度。: Review churn monthly to judge retention health.
map.由流失率推客户平均生命周期与 LTV。: Derive average customer lifetime and LTV from churn.
map.分群对比付费/免费用户流失差异。: Compare churn between paying and free cohorts.
map.期初 1000 人、当月流失 50 → 流失率=5%、留存率 95%；平均生命周: Starting customers 1000 with 50 lost in the month gives churn 5% and retention 95%; average lifetime = 1/5% = 20 months; with ARPU 100 CNY a month, LTV (gross revenue) = 100/0.05 = 2000 CNY.
map.流失率≤3% 优秀、3–7% 良好、7–12% 一般、>12% 预警；某 Saa: Churn ≤ 3% is excellent, 3-7% good, 7-12% average and above 12% a warning; a SaaS losing 9% a month sits at "average" and needs win-back.
map.流失率用人数还是金额？: Should churn be measured in customers or revenue?
map.人数看活跃、金额看收入，高价值客户流失更伤，建议双指标监控。: Headcount shows activity and revenue shows income; losing high-value customers hurts more, so monitor both.
map.生命周期能直接当 LTV 吗？: Can lifetime be used directly as LTV?
map.生命周期×ARPU 是毛收入口径，扣成本与服务费才是净 LTV，且假设流失率恒定: Lifetime × ARPU is a gross revenue figure; deducting cost and service fees gives net LTV, and it assumes churn stays constant.
